title: Graphoid Automata, Frobenius PROPs, and Semiring Evaluation
summary: Graphoid automata evaluate graphs by composing relations between words of states. We examine the equations that make this evaluation independent of the chosen graph expression, and what changes when relations are replaced by matrices over a commutative semiring. We prove that the classical graphoid equations are equivalent to the special commutative Frobenius equations together with the required symmetry laws.
